plainTranslation: Communication grinds against authority. The Mercury person feels criticized, doubted, or shut down; the Saturn person finds the other's thinking loose or unserious. Conversations go heavy or cold. Failure mode: the Saturn person belittling the Mercury person's mind. Workable if Saturn offers structure without judgment and Mercury hears rigor, not rejection.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry aspect material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
